title: ervum hookeri
intro: Ervum hookeri, commonly known as Indian bean or Horse gram, is a legume plant that is native to the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia. This plant has been traditionally used to provide relief from various health issues, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and aiding in the management of diabetes and obesity, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ervum hookeri include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic properties, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The bioactive constituents of Ervum hookeri include glycosides, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and contribute to its potential health benefits.
